name: img.std/aokvqa/aokvqa
source: A-OKVQA, validation split, multiple-choice setting (Schwenk et al., 2022)

name: img.std/gqa/gqa
license: No license stated; images and scene graphs from Visual Genome (CC BY 4.0)
criteria_source: yes/no answers: boolean; 'X or Y' questions: the two alternatives of the question program; other answers: gold + 3 gold answers of other questions of the same detailed type
notes: Stratified by structural type (query, verify, logical, choose, compare).

name: img.std/mmmu/mmmu
source: MMMU, validation split, multiple-choice questions (Yue et al., 2024)
license: Apache-2.0 (release); images from the sources it cites
notes: Stratified by subject; the 53 open questions are left out. `<image N>` in the question is placed inline; images named only in options are separate state keys.

name: img.std/naturalbench/naturalbench
criteria_source: yes/no questions: boolean; multiple-choice: the options written in the question
notes: 250 samples stratified by question type (yes/no, multiple choice), two items each (500). The official group accuracy (all four answers right) is not reported here.

name: img.std/okvqa/okvqa
criteria_source: most frequent of 10 annotator answers + 3 gold answers of other questions of the same knowledge category
notes: Stratified by knowledge category. gold.dist: the 10 annotator answers over the options.

name: img.std/scienceqa/scienceqa
source: ScienceQA, test split, questions with an image (Lu et al., 2022)
notes: Stratified by subject. Hint kept as context; lecture and solution are not shown.

name: img.std/vizwiz_qa/vizwiz_vqa
criteria_source: most frequent of 10 answers + gold answers of other questions of the same answer category + 'unanswerable'
notes: Stratified by answer category (other, unanswerable, yes/no, number). Four options; yes/no questions get yes, no and unanswerable. gold.dist: the 10 answers over the options.
